# 🧩 Backend Project Templates

Use these templates for changes to the Express API, Mongoose models, authentication, uploads, and deployment. Replace bracketed prompts. Never paste live credentials, cookies, user records, or private file paths.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [API change proposal](api-change.md) | Contract and compatibility planning |
| [Endpoint specification](endpoint-specification.md) | Define method, auth, inputs, and responses |
| [Database migration plan](database-migration.md) | Schema changes, rollout, and rollback |
| [Security review](security-review.md) | Threats and mitigations for a change |
| [Incident report](incident-report.md) | Capture operational impact safely |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Unit, integration, and negative testing |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Pre-release and rollback readiness |
| [Architecture decision record](architecture-decision.md) | Record technical decisions |

Templates are review aids, not evidence that a feature exists or is secure.
